# `tfctl api schema search`

The `tfctl api schema search` command searches API operations by keywords.

## Usage

```shell-session
$ tfctl api schema search QUERY [QUERY ...] [options]
```

## Description

The `tfctl api schema search` command searches the HCP Terraform API operations by keywords. Use this command to discover available API endpoints when you don't know the exact operation ID or path.

The search finds case-insensitive matches against operation IDs, paths, summaries, and descriptions in the OpenAPI specification. You can provide multiple search terms to narrow your results.

Use [`tfctl api schema get`](/terraform/tfctl-cli/reference/cli/api/schema/get) to view details for a specific result.

## Arguments

- `QUERY [QUERY ...]`: (Required) The search query to match against API operations. You can provide multiple keywords to refine your search.

## Available options

The `tfctl api schema search` command does not support any command-specific options.

### Global flags

Refer to [Global flags reference](/terraform/tfctl-cli/reference/cli#global-flags) for information about flags you can use with all commands.

## Output

The command outputs a list of matching operations, including the operation ID, HTTP method, API path, and a summary.

Example output:

```text
Operation ID                      Method   Path                                                              Summary
createWorkspace                   POST     /organizations/{organization_name}/workspaces                     Create a Workspace
createWorkspaceTransfer           POST     /workspace-transfers                                              Create a Workspace Transfer
cancelWorkspaceTransfer           POST     /workspace-transfers/{workspace_transfer_id}/actions/cancel       Cancel a Workspace Transfer
resumeWorkspaceTransfer           POST     /workspace-transfers/{workspace_transfer_id}/actions/resume       Resume a Workspace Transfer
deleteWorkspace                   DELETE   /workspaces/{workspace_id}                                        Delete a Workspace
getWorkspace                      GET      /workspaces/{workspace_id}                                        Get a Workspace
updateWorkspace                   PATCH    /workspaces/{workspace_id}                                        Update a Workspace
addPolicySetWorkspaceExclusions   POST     /policy-sets/{policy_set_id}/relationships/workspace-exclusions   Add Workspace Exclusions to a Policy Set
listWorkspaceTransfers            GET      /workspace-transfers                                              List Workspace Transfers
addTeamAccess                     POST     /team-workspaces                                                  Add Team Access to a Workspace
```

Use the operation ID from the results with `tfctl api schema get` to view the full schema for a specific operation.

## Examples

The following examples demonstrate how to search for API operations by keyword.

### Search for workspace operations

The following example searches for API operations that mention the term "workspace".

```shell-session
$ tfctl api schema search workspace
```

### Search with multiple keywords

The following example searches for API operations that mention the terms "workspace" and "create".

```shell-session
$ tfctl api schema search workspace create
```

### Search for run-related operations

```shell-session
$ tfctl api schema search run
```

### Search for variable operations

```shell-session
$ tfctl api schema search variable
```
